The workbook generation failed due to invalid Excel formulas resulting in #NAME? errors in the statistics section.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed with an AssertionError in /tests/test_outputs.py. Specifically, cells H46 through L47 in the 'Task' worksheet returned '#NAME?' instead of the expected floating-point values (e.g., H46 expected -3.5737762237762265). This error typically indicates that openpyxl is writing a formula with a typo or a function name that Excel/the verifier does not recognize. While basic sheet structure and lookup blocks passed, the statistical calculations are broken.
